title: Add Relative Strength Index (RSI)
description: RSI (Elder ch. 27), missing entirely from this codebase, is a closing-price-only oscillator: `RSI = 100 - 100/(1 + RS)`, `RS` = average of net up-closes over N days / average of net down-closes over the same N days (7-9 days sharpens signals per the book; this app's other oscillators use varying windows, decide and record). Selling point over Stochastic (already implemented): RSI is less noisy and its signals tend to emerge earlier per Elder's own side-by-side comparison. This task is computation + exposure only -- wiring RSI into _determine_signal or the divergence detector (backend-divergence-detection, a separate task) is out of scope.

checklist.step: Implement rsi() in backend/app/indicators/rsi.py following the existing indicator module conventions (see stochastic.py for the pattern).
Hand-computed reference-value test (a small OHLC series with RSI worked out by hand, not just golden-output regression).
Decide the default window (7, 9, or 14 days -- the book leans toward 7-9 for sharper signals but doesn't mandate one) and record as a decisions entry.
Expose alongside Stochastic in the analysis/indicator-history responses.
Regenerate backend/openapi.json and frontend/src/api/types.ts; document in docs/Analyse.md's indicator table.
